title:
A "documentation comment" is a special comment that has structure used to document a class, method or field.
In Java and JavaScript, this is multi-line comment that opens with "/**" and appears immediately before the
structure being documented. In Python it is a triple-quoted literal that appears first within the function or class
being documented.

A documentation comment is meant for the user of the structure and thus represents "external documentation" while
other comments are meant for the reader of the code itself and thus represent "internal documentation".
